detail.longDescription: 😊 TIL: Psychological researchers tested more than 1,100 people to see whether posing a # smile reliably lifts mood. A single smile gave a modest # happiness boost, especially after unpleasant images. Repeating the smile weakened the effect, and adding a threat of lost pay erased it or made people less happy. 👉 https:// scitechdaily.com/smiling-isnt- always-good-for-you-scientists-discover/ # smiling # emotions # psychology # research # science # experiment # behavior # feelings # stress # mind
